They are seriously having a laugh.
Ships from and sold by BuyGlobal. This is where I hope people do there research and take notice of what they are buying and not just assume its a good deal because it's on Amazon.
[User #4295932 postsmarsupialWhirlpool Enthusiast] Yes I know it isn't sold by Amazon but still BuyGlobal is having a great laugh here, do they think we are idiots or something?
[User #1503902385 postsGroggleWhirlpool Forums Addict] This just like complaining "ebay ripped me off".
The seller is using the platform, do your research first.
[User #4295932 postsmarsupialWhirlpool Enthusiast] Not really I didn't buy it so I didn't get ripped off. It doesn't detract from the fact that this company selling this product is just treating us like morons or desperadoes. I realise this company is "just using the platform" but it is still a joke regardless.
That sort of behaviour turns me off, I will have them on my blacklist from now on regardless of price, just banned in my mind :-)
[User #3944133654 postsRocket ManWhirlpool Forums Addict] interfreak writes...
I wonder if the rumoured boxing day sales will eventuate?
It'll be their last chance to make a go of the launch this year, if that is any yardstick for them to measure by.
Any normal company I'd say absolutely , there is some Project Manager with a "2017" goal that determines his bonus, but with Amazon, who knows.
[User #7273942777 postsnoqualmsWhirlpool Forums Addict] Hopefully in a years time, we'll be finding significantly more deals on the site, as it stands now, it looks like you'd be a fool to switch most of your online shopping to Amazon. Best keep options open with AliExpress, Ebay, local online stores, etc.
[User #7909673400 postsKonichiwaWhirlpool Forums Addict] noqualms writes...
Hopefully in a years time, we'll be finding significantly more deals on the site, as it stands now, it looks like you'd be a fool to switch most of your online shopping to Amazon. Best keep options open with AliExpress, Ebay, local online stores, etc.
Yeah I'm really hoping they come good eventually. Even items sold by Amazon themselves are way over priced compared to local stores. What's the point of ordering online when I can go locally and get it cheaper. Half the time you can talk down the bricks and mortar in price as well.
Even their range sucks, barely any audio gear, music instruments or power tools.
[User #166641863 postsmarty2Whirlpool Enthusiast] Rocket Man writes...
It'll be their last chance to make a go of the launch this year, if that is any yardstick for them to measure by.
Amazon don't really have blockbuster sales. Even in the US the balck Friday, cyber Monday and the other big sale they had were crap. I'd give it another year or so before you can really judge if they are successful. They will get the bugs ironed out and the prices will be competitive, but convenience will be high.
[User #22984818615 postsBucksawayIn the penalty box] noqualms writes...
as it stands now, it looks like you'd be a fool to switch most of your online shopping to Amazon. Best keep options open with AliExpress, Ebay, local online stores, etc.
You're a fool if you don't do this regardless of Amazon
[User #78377725 postsBardwranglerI'm new here, please be nice] Probably has been said before but StarTrack and AUSPost have really stepped up their game lately. I've had deliveries from both Companies and they have been left in perfect spots while I'm not home and also have gotten two loads of sunday deliveries.
I hope the workers get a huge bonus this year for their hard work.
[User #7273942777 postsnoqualmsWhirlpool Forums Addict] Bucksaway writes...
You're a fool if you don't do this regardless of Amazon
Within reason. What if Amazon matched those sites or within 3% Do you really care to save 3% on ebay, if you're doing 98% of your online shopping on Amazon anyhow?
There comes a point, it's just easier to grab anything on Amazon. It's pretty common in San Francisco. My girl has moved here from there, she'd never used ebay before and was baffled why we use it here.
[User #2592358277 postskevin-007Whirlpool Forums Addict] noqualms writes...
There comes a point, it's just easier to grab anything on Amazon
I hear what you're saying, but based on some of the angst surrounding buyers remorse in various WP threads (esp computers), I fear that you're underestimating the willingness of some of WP to do pretty much anything to get a few bucks off what everyone else seems to be paying for a given item. On one of the thriftier US audio forums I've visited, this is known as a 'score' (often stylised as 'scr0e') and being able to detail said score seems far more important to some than the actual goods purchased. The convenience of Amazon or any single online sales portal will always play second fiddle to bragging rights for these folk.
[User #80697232 postsADSL User 888Cloud is ****Whirlpool Forums Addict] So what's peoples opinions on Amazon after its soft launch a while ago?. Overhyped?.disappointing?. Has the range grown much at this point?
[User #7038035095 postsalmondy23Eat an almond nutWhirlpool Forums Addict] Excalibard writes...
StarTrack and AUSPost have really stepped up their game lately.
Are you serious? Where I live, for a whole year both star track and AP have been claiming they attempt delivery, when they don't even stop at our apartment complex. We don't even get delivery slips, so parcels go missing all the time; LPOs can't even locate them without delivery slips.
Makes the whole online shopping thing exceedingly frustrating.
